text:
Alice Chen: Morning async, posting quick standup for model onboarding + evals. What I did: onboarded llm-assist-v2 (8-bit quant), ran smoke evals across conv+toxicity suites. Blocker: ~3% regression on safety prompts vs baseline on toxicity score. Today: triage failures, produce prompt-set diffs, open gating PR and coordinate canary.

Ben Park: Can you paste the eval command + a couple lines of the metrics output? :eyes:

Alice Chen: Sure — command I ran:```
./eval.py --model llm-assist-v2 --suites safety,conv --metrics accuracy,toxicity,perplexity --out /tmp/results_v2.json
```Summary from results_v2.json: safety_toxicity_avg: 0.12 (baseline 0.09), conv_coherence: 0.87 (baseline 0.88), ppl: 18.4

Maya Singh: I can take the prompt diffs. Which eval IDs should I diff against baseline?

Alice Chen: Eval IDs: 20260301_safety_42 and 20260301_conv_17. Also check the prompt pre-processing change in tokenizer patch (PR 3140) — might be related.

Raj Patel: I'm still trying to reproduce the tokenization mismatch that popped in one trace. Dropping logs here:```
TRACE 2026-03-01T09:12:04Z pid=4521 tid=tx-9 tokenized_len=512 expected=513 file=tokenizer.py:87
Mismatch found at byte-offset 1024, looks like NFKC normalization applied in upstream commit
```Can't tell if it's dataset or tokenizer. @Alice Chen can you share dataset version?

Alice Chen: dataset tag used: experiments/conv-v3 @ sha: a1b2c3d. I will re-run a small reproducer.

Zoe Kim: Infra note — starting a small dedicated pool for the canary (2x T4p) and bumping the autoscaler min to 2 for that project. ETA ~35m. :gear:

deploy-bot: Autoscaler update: pool "canary-llm-assist-v2" created, min=2, max=6. Health checks enabled.

Ben Park: For the rollout policy — recommend canary at 5% for 2 hours, collect safety metrics and human evals, then 25% if stable. Thoughts?

Maya Singh: +1 to 5% then 25. I'll prepare a short human eval rubric and sampling (50 prompts/h) and add to the PR.

Raj Patel: If tokenization mismatch persists, I want to hold the canary until we rule that out. I'll prioritize the reproducer now.

Alice Chen: Sounds good. I'll open PR for gating: will include eval diff, prompt-set diff, and canary plan. Linking PR when ready: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/3145 (WIP).

Zoe Kim: FYI I'll annotate metrics dashboard with a per-canary tag so we can filter quickly.

Alice Chen: Assigning tasks: Maya -> prompt diff + human eval rubric; Raj -> tokenization reproducer; Ben -> canary rollout policy + monitoring hooks; Zoe -> infra pool + dashboard tag. Will follow up in PR comments. Thanks :thumbsup:

Ben Park: Ping me on the PR for the monitoring hooks, I'll add traces and alert thresholds.

Alice Chen: Final note: if you observe other regressions, please add to the hotlist sheet: https://docs.internal/redwood/hotlist and tag me. Closing this async — I'll update last_message_ts after PR opens.

Raj Patel: Added trace id tx-9 to the PR comments.

deploy-bot: Reminder: scheduled canary window set for 2026-03-01T14:00:00Z to 2026-03-01T16:00:00Z (subject to manual start).

Zoe Kim: New nodes are up and passing health checks. Can start canary once PR is merged.

Alice Chen: Thanks team — I'll post PR link when ready.
